bugs.summary: .updateMethodsInTable for group generics inefficiently over-checks signatures (up and down groups)
bugs.creator: michaelchirico4

comments.creator: michaelchirico4
comments.text:
Created attachment 3935
Avoid redundancy in .updateMethodsInTable recursion

`.updateMethodsInTable()` recursively checks levels of group generics have consistent signature lengths with `.checkGroupSigLength`, but `.checkGroupSigLength` itself recurses across the whole tree of its input, so this is redundant+inefficient.

This was uncovered as part of the bottleneck leading to slow `loadNamespace()` times for {RProtoBuf}. Gemini devised the following tracer (edited for readability) to show the problem:

```
n_update_methods <- 0L
n_check_group_sig <- 0L
n_get_generic <- 0L

trace(methods:::.updateMethodsInTable, tracer = quote({
  n_update_methods <<- n_update_methods + 1L
  cat(sprintf("[update #%02d] generic=%-12s isGroup=%-5s @group='%s'\n",
              n_update_methods,
              generic@generic,
              is(generic, "groupGenericFunction"),
              toString(unlist(generic@group))))
}), print = FALSE)

trace(methods:::.checkGroupSigLength,
      tracer = quote({
        n_check_group_sig <<- n_check_group_sig + 1L
        cat(sprintf("  -> [.checkGroupSigLength #%02d] gnames=(%s)\n",
                    n_check_group_sig, toString(unlist(gnames))))
        # nested trace() to exclude other getGeneric calls
        suppressMessages(trace(
          methods::getGeneric,
          tracer = quote({ n_get_generic <<- n_get_generic + 1L }),
          print = FALSE))
      }),
      exit = quote(suppressMessages(untrace(methods::getGeneric))),
      print = FALSE)

# 1. Cold Ops: Rcpp has "Ops" in .requireCachedGenerics (defines 0 Ops methods)
invisible(loadNamespace("Rcpp"))
cat(sprintf(
  "\nloadNamespace('Rcpp'): .updateMethodsInTable=%d, .checkGroupSigLength=%d, getGeneric(in checkGroup)=%d\n\n",
  n_update_methods, n_check_group_sig, n_get_generic
))

# 2. Warm Ops: cli ALSO has "Ops" in .requireCachedGenerics (and defines 0 Ops methods)
n_update_methods <- 0L; n_check_group_sig <- 0L; n_get_generic <- 0L
invisible(loadNamespace("cli"))
cat(sprintf(
  "\nloadNamespace('cli'):  .updateMethodsInTable=%d, .checkGroupSigLength=%d, getGeneric(in checkGroup)=%d\n",
  n_update_methods, n_check_group_sig, n_get_generic
))
```

In all, we get the following `loadNamespace()` timings in current r-devel:

```
time for ii in {1..20};   do bin/Rscript -e 'for (pkg in c("rlang", "cli", "glue", "fs", "bench", "tibble", "dplyr", "readr", "vroom", "dbplyr")) loadNamespace(pkg)'; done

# real    0m17.326s
# user    0m14.662s
# sys     0m2.773s
```

which go down 25% with the proposed patch:

```
# real    0m13.033s
# user    0m10.681s
# sys     0m2.465s
```

These packages were chosen intentionally as outliers -- the ineffiency for them is particularly noteworthy because none of them define `Ops` methods, `Ops` only shows up because of `setOldClass()` populating it to their `.requireCachedGenerics`.

Other cases that actually use group generics for Ops benefit too, and the number of redundant cases can explode if `Math` is involved (e.g. a 90% reduction in `getGeneric` calls from >30,000 to <3,000):

```
time for ii in {1..20};   do bin/Rscript -e 'for (pkg in c("kernlab", "Matrix", "lme4", "S4Vectors")) loadNamespace(pkg)'; done

# BEFORE
# real    0m55.285s
# user    0m49.618s
# sys     0m5.775s

# AFTER (40% reduction)
# real    0m32.808s
# user    0m28.308s
# sys     0m4.612s
```

Other cases are more modest (e.g. as low as 10% for Rcpp+cli+RProtoBuf).

Tracking on GitHub: https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/pull/392
